name: gossamer-preview
description: The canvas for agentic coding. Live-preview HTML docs, UIs, and interfaces your AI agent generates.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

commands.title: Gossamer Preview: Open Current HTML File

gossamer-preview.telemetry.enabled.description: Send anonymous usage and error telemetry to help improve Gossamer Preview. We collect: extension version, preview opened/closed events, shortcut usage, and errors. We never collect: file contents, file paths, or anything that identifies you personally. The identifier is VS Code's anonymous machineId. This setting is Gossamer Preview's only telemetry gate — disabling it stops all Gossamer telemetry. The global VS Code telemetry setting (`telemetry.telemetryLevel`) does not affect Gossamer Preview; control it here.

gossamer-preview.allowedLocalhostPorts.description: Additional localhost ports your previewed HTML is allowed to fetch() from. Gossamer already allows common dev ports (3000, 5173, 7654, 7655, 8000, 8080, etc.); add any extras here. Reopen the preview after changing this. Without portMapping the VS Code webview service worker blocks localhost responses with a CORS error.
